ud6.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
ud6.1:1.3: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya vesāliṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
ud6.1:1.4: vesāliyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
ud6.1:2.1: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā nisīdanamādāya bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi.
ud6.1:2.2: atha kho bhagavā yena cāpālaṃ cetiyaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
ud6.1:2.3: nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
ud6.1:3.1: ramaṇīyā ānanda vesālī, ramaṇīyaṃ udenaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ gotamakaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ sattambaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ bahuputtaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ sārandadaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ cāpālaṃ cetiyaṃ.
ud6.1:3.2: yassa kassa ci ānanda, cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā, so ākaṅkhamāno kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā.
ud6.1:3.3: tathāgatassa kho ānanda, cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā. ākaṅkhamāno ānanda, tathāgato kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā’ti.
ud6.1:4.1: evampi kho āyasmā ānando bhagavatā oḷārike nimitte kayiramāne oḷārike obhāse kayiramāne nāsakkhi paṭivijjhituṃ.
ud6.1:4.3: tiṭṭhatu bhante, bhagavā kappaṃ, tiṭṭhatu sugato kappaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānanti. yathā taṃ mārena pariyuṭṭhitacitto.
ud6.1:4.4: dutiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi: ‘ramaṇīyā …pe… tathāgato kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā’ti. evampi kho āyasmā ānando …pe… yathā taṃ mārena pariyuṭṭhitacitto.
ud6.1:4.5: tatiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
ud6.1:5.3: tathāgato kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā’ti.
ud6.1:7.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
ud6.1:7.3: evaṃ bhante’ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā avidūre aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi.
ud6.1:8.1: atha kho māro pāpimā acirapakkante āyasmante ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho māro pāpimā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
ud6.1:9.1: ‘parinibbātu bhante, bhagavā. parinibbātu sugato. parinibbānakālo’dāni bhante bhagavato.
ud6.1:9.2: bhāsitā kho panesā bhante bhagavatā vācā:
ud6.1:9.3: na tāvāhaṃ pāpima, parinibbāyissāmi yāva me bhikkhū na sāvakā bhavissanti, viyattā vinītā visāradā yogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammappaṭipannā sāmīcippaṭipannā anudhammacārino sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desessanti paññapessanti paṭṭhapessanti vivarissanti vibhajissanti uttānī karissanti uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desessantī’ti.
ud6.1:9.4: santi kho pana bhante etarahi bhikkhū bhagavato sāvakā viyattā vinītā visāradā yogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammappaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacārino, sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhanti desenti paññapenti paṭṭhapenti vivaranti vibhajanti uttāniṃ karonti uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti.
ud6.1:9.5: parinibbātu bhante, bhagavā. parinibbātu sugato. parinibbānakālo’dāni, bhante, bhagavato.
ud6.1:10.1: bhāsitā kho panesā bhante bhagavatā vācā:
ud6.1:10.2: ‘na tāvāhaṃ pāpima, parinibbāyissāmi, yāva me bhikkhuniyo na sāvikā bhavissanti viyattā …pe… anudhammacāriniyo …pe… sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desessantī’ti.
ud6.1:10.3: santi kho pana bhante, etarahi bhikkhuniyo bhagavato sāvikā viyattā …pe… sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti.
ud6.1:11.2: na tāvāhaṃ pāpima, parinibbāyissāmi, yā va me upāsakā na sāvakā bhavissanti viyattā …pe… sappaṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desessantī’ti.
ud6.1:11.3: santi kho pana bhante, etarahi upāsakā bhagavato sāvakā viyattā …pe… sappaṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti.
ud6.1:12.2: na tāvāhaṃ pāpima, parinibbāyissāmi, yāva me upāsikā na sāvakā bhavissanti viyattā …pe… anudhammacāriniyo …pe… sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desessantī’ti.
ud6.1:12.3: santi kho pana bhante, etarahi upāsikā bhagavato sāvikā viyattā …pe… anudhammacāriniyo …pe… sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti.
ud6.1:13.2: na tāvāhaṃ pāpima, parinibbāyissāmi, yāva me idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na iddhañceva bhavissati phītañca vitthārikaṃ bāhujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ yāvadeva manussehi suppakāsita’nti.
ud6.1:13.3: etarahi kho pana bhante bhagavato brahmacariyaṃ iddhañceva phītañca vitthārikaṃ bāhujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ yāvadeva manussehi suppakāsitaṃ.
ud6.1:13.4: parinibbātu’dāni, bhante, bhagavā. parinibbātu sugato. parinibbānakālo’dāni bhante bhagavato”ti.
ud6.1:14.1: evaṃ vutte bhagavā māraṃ pāpimantaṃ etadavoca:
ud6.1:14.2: appossukko tvaṃ pāpima, hohi. na ciraṃ tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati.
ud6.1:14.3: ito tiṇṇaṃ māsānaṃ accayena tathāgato parinibbāyissatī”ti.
ud6.1:15.1: atha kho bhagavā cāpāle cetiye sato sampajāno āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossajji.
ud6.1:15.2: ossaṭṭhe ca bhagavatā āyusaṅkhāre mahābhūmicālo ahosi, bhiṃsanako lomahaṃso. devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu.
ud6.1:16.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
